name: Infestation Investigation
summary: In Thendal Grove, cirrusflies swarm the eastern woods. Ranger Elatrell Featherlight sends young defenders to thin their growing numbers before nearby settlements are at risk.

sections.title: A Swarm in the Canopy
sections.body: Local rangers report a sudden rise in cirrusflies along Thendal Grove’s eastern edge. One is a minor pest, but a swarm grows aggressive and destructive. So Ranger Elatrell Featherlight sends capable youths to cull the insects before they overwhelm the grove.

sections.title: Early Steps of Service
sections.body: After coming of age, young defenders help keep Zephras Isle safe. Clearing pests protects nearby settlements from outbreaks in the woods. Yet entrails and insects clinging to returning hunters show the swarm is far larger than first feared.

faq.answer: Cirrusflies are winged insect pests native to Zephras Isle. Alone, they are small, but they multiply quickly and can form dangerous swarms in places like Thendal Grove.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Infestation Investigation?
faq.answer: Elatrell Featherlight gives the assignment. The ranger is stationed in Thendal Grove and watches the local wildlife and surrounding woods.
Cirrusflies gather in the eastern and southeastern reaches of Thendal Grove on Zephras Isle. They are found among the foliage and young vuldren.

faq.q: Why is culling the cirrusflies important?
faq.answer: A single cirrusfly poses little danger, but a swarm can grow dense enough to threaten travelers, consume local plants, and upset Thendal Grove’s balance.
After you thin the swarm and report to Elatrell Featherlight, you are sent toward the heart of the infestation to face the Cirrusfly Queen.

faq.q: Where does this quest fit into the early journey on Zephras?
faq.answer: The assignment comes right after the Coming of Age trial. It is one of the first combat duties given to newly recognized defenders of Zephras Isle.

angles.text: As a hunter, you track cirrusflies darting among the trees and practice leading fast-moving targets through dense cover.
As a druid, you help preserve Thendal Grove by addressing natural imbalances before aggressive swarms strip the woodland bare.
